title: Bitcoin’s Bullish Signal Has Been Confirmed: Could $100,000 Be Next?
summary: Three weeks ago, I wrote on IBKR Campus that Bitcoin appeared to be approaching an important turning point.At the time, Bitcoin had already rebounded sharply from its summer lows, but the more interesting part of the analysis was not the rebound itself. It was the combination of three independent signals: improving speculative positioning, the breakout of an almost one-year descending trendline, and what appeared to be the beginning of a new phase in Bitcoin’s two-year cycle.
